subject: Post-discovery follow-up — scheduling ops + product deep-dive
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Megan Torres <megan.torres@quantize.ai>, DevOps <ops@quantize.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery follow-up — scheduling ops + product deep-dive

Hi Megan / Quantize team,

Thanks again for taking the discovery call with us earlier this week — appreciate you making time. Looks like the follow-up deep-dive was bumped and I saw the invite was missed. No problem at all — these things happen.

To keep momentum, we want to split the next touch into two focused sessions so your engineering and product/ops teams get exactly what they need:

- Option A (split): two focused sessions — 12 minutes Ops alignment (networking, VPC/KMS, ingress/egress patterns) + 35 minutes Product/Platform deep-dive (routing, batching, cost controls).
- Option B (single): one consolidated 45-minute deep-dive with both teams together.

Marcus (SE) will own the Ops portion; I will run the product walk-through. Can you confirm which format you prefer and which of the slots below work for your team? If you can confirm within 24 hours we’ll lock the time; otherwise we’ll release the holds.

Proposed windows (all times in EDT):
- Tue 10/20: 10:00–10:47 (single 47m slot for a consolidated session)
- Wed 10/21: 09:30–10:15 (split: 09:30–09:42 Ops; 09:45–10:20 Product)
- Thu 10/22: 15:00–15:47 (single 47m slot)
- Fri 10/23: 08:00–08:47 (split: 08:00–08:12 Ops; 08:15–08:50 Product)

Attachments: redwood-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (agenda + checklist), soc2-evidence-request.xlsx (starter list we typically ask customers to prepare).

If those don't work, send 2–3 times that do and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0184

From: Megan Torres <megan.torres@quantize.ai>

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-discovery follow-up — scheduling ops + product deep-dive

Hi Olga —

Sorry about the no-show earlier; an exec standup ran over and I couldn't jump onto the invite. Appreciate you following up.

Split sessions sound ideal — our platform/infra folks prefer smaller focused touchpoints. Our team is available for the Wed/Thu split windows but Thursday at 15:00 ET is tight because we have a release cut.

Our quick preferences (all ET):
- Wed 10/21: yes for the split (09:30 / 09:45) — Marcus' Ops time is especially helpful.
- Fri 10/23: possible but prefer earlier in the day for our west-coast folks.

Questions:
1) For the Ops piece, can Marcus cover expected egress patterns and recommended KMS/KV cache key handling?
2) For the consolidated meeting, do you have a short pre-req list so we can pull the right people / artifacts?

I can confirm formally after syncing with our ops lead (cc'd). If Wed 10/21 works, we should lock that within the day.

— Megan
Megan Torres
Head of Platform
Quantize AI
megan.torres@quantize.ai | (617) 555-0102

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>

On Mon, Oct 19, 2026 at 11:03 AM EDT, Megan Torres <megan.torres@quantize.ai> wrote:
> Split sessions sound ideal — our platform/infra folks prefer smaller focused touchpoints.

Thanks Megan — we’ll plan the split then. Quick notes on scope and deliverables so everyone is aligned:

Ops (12 minutes):
- Networking paths we recommend for low-latency inference (VPC peering / PrivateLink patterns).
- KMS/HSM integration options and tokenization handling (high-level).
- What we need from you pre-call: small network diagram and list of your KMS provider (1 slide).

Product (35 minutes):
- Routing policies, fallbacks, and cost-control knobs (batching / quantization suggestions).
- Live demo: per-route latency & cost dashboard, and a short run-through of rollout policies.
- Pre-call: sample prompt patterns or traffic profile (5–10 examples).

Confirming slot: Wed 2026-10-21 — Ops 09:30–09:42 ET; Product 09:45–10:20 ET.
Please confirm by EOD Tue 2026-10-20; otherwise we’ll release the holds at 9am Wed.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference
